create_simple_env: create a SimpleEnv instance with a custom size and obstacle size for 2D planning tests
create_simple_env_with_obs: create a SimpleEnv with a fixed obstacle position by passing an obs numpy array
get_configuration_space: get a 2D ConfigurationSpace object from SimpleEnv for use in motion planning algorithms
validate_configuration: validate whether a 2D point is feasible by checking bounds and obstacle collision
show_trajectory: display the SimpleEnv scene with trajectory states plotted as blue circles and lines
